title: Rational design of superalkali-based novel calix[4]pyridine alkalides as high performance nonlinear optical materials
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,6147-6161
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08399G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Rehana Bano, Khurshid Ayub, Tariq Mahmood, Muhammad Arshad, Ahsan Sharif, Asim Laeeq Khan, Hamad AlMohamadi, Muhammad Yasin, Mazhar Amjad Gilani
Doping superalkali clusters and Li atoms on opposite sides of calix[4]pyridine can generate novel alkalide materials with exceptional NLO properties, as indicated by their high static first hyperpolarizability of 2.5 × 106 au.
